name: family-look
authority: contour.json, the page 9 profile, used as one nine-slice on every surface

corner_px.rule: one corner for every surface, never scaled to the surface's own size

surfaces.name: window frame
surfaces.drawn_by: ui/contour.js contourWindowPath(w, h) which delegates to contourPath(w, h, pad)
surfaces.mask: window.py contour_region at pad 0.0, outside the drawn outline

layers: the body paints through a path clip at 0.5, so the fill edge is the contour
the frame is the same contour stroked at 1 px, inset 1.5, drawn whole
the window mask never cuts the outline; it sits at the window box
